blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Extraction pipelines ask language models for JSON that follows a schema, and the schema can set a minimum number of list entries. We ask what models do when the document holds fewer items than that minimum. Under a preregistered plan, we test eight open-weight models on 558 real documents from nine annotated datasets, with six more models on hosted services as a reference. Three findings stand out. First, models treat the count as a target: a minimum shown in the schema, but not enforced, raises the share of lists longer than the true count from 34.5% to 55.4%. Second, the padding is hard to catch, because most added entries are real text taken from the document; about half of them pass a check that each entry occurs in the source. Third, common fixes help only partly: a line saying fewer items are fine removes the effect on average but misses more true items, a count in prose ("up to k") also raises over-counting, an "N/A" option under an enforced minimum still leaves half the lists padded, and re-asking with the validation error makes padding far more common. We release the code, answer lists and run records at https://github.com/AbhishekBarali/padding-to-k
blocks.zh: 采掘管道向JSON查询遵循一个计划的语言模型,计划可以设定最低列表条目数. 我们问,当文件所载项目少于这一最低限度时,模式会做什么。 根据预先注册的计划,我们在9个附加说明的数据集的558个真实文件中测试8个开放量级模型,另外6个关于主机服务的模型作为参考. 三种发现突出. 首先,模型将计数视为一个目标:在计数计划中显示的最小值,但并未执行,比真实计数更长的占比从34.5%提高到55.4%. 其次,粘贴很难捕捉,因为大多数添加的条目都是从文档中取来的真文本;其中约一半通过检查,每个条目都发生在来源中. 第三,常见的修补仅能部分帮助:一行说更少的项目是精细的,可以去除平均效果,但漏掉了更真实的项目,一个借词("上至k")的计数也会引起过量计算,一个强制最小值下的"N/A"选项仍然留下一半的列表的加词,用校验错误重新询问使得加词更加常见. 我们在https://github.com/Abhishek Barali/pading-to-k上发布代码、答复清单和运行记录。

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Extraction systems ask language models for structured output: a JSON object that follows a JSON Schema.
The schema, or the prompt around it, can say how many entries a list must have, for example with "minItems": 3 .
That is harmless when the document holds at least that many items.
When it holds fewer, the request cannot be met truthfully: an email with one request cannot yield three true requests (Figure 1 ).
Real schemas set list minimums: of the 9,542 real-world schemas in JSONSchemaBench ( Geng et al., 2025 ) , 7.7% put a minItems of at least 1 on a list of strings or objects, which an empty document cannot meet; minimums of 2 or more are rarer (0.3%; post hoc, Appendix M ).
blocks.zh:
提取系统询问结构输出的语言模型:一个遵循了JSON Schema的JSON对象.
计划,或周围的提示,可以说明一个列表必须有多少条目,例如有"min Projects": 3 (英语).
如果文件至少持有这么多物品,那就无害。
当请求数量减少时,无法真实地满足请求:一个请求的电子邮件不能产生三个真正的请求(图1)。
真正的计划设置列表最小值: 在 JSONSchema 中的 9,542个现实世界计划 法官(Geng等人,2025年),7.7%将至少1个小项目列入字符串或对象清单,空文件不能满足;最少2个或更多(0.3%;临时后,附录M)。

blocks.en:
We fix what a correct output is in advance (Sections 3.4 and 3.5 ).
When the document holds n < k n<k true items, a correct output lists the n n items and stops, or marks the list as short with a placeholder, an “N/A” where one is offered, or a note.
Padding the list with entries that are not true items is the failure, whether the padding is invented or taken from the document.
Section 3.4 gives the reasons for this reading, and Section 5 the evidence that the minimum, not the schema, causes the padding.
blocks.zh:
我们确定事先的正确产出(第3.4和3.5节)。
当文档持有 n < k n < k < k 真实项目时, 正确的输出会列出 n 项并停止, 或者用占位符、 “ N/ A” 表示列表的短处 , 或 注释 。
以不真实的条目对列表进行打分是失败, 无论是创建还是取自文档 。
第3.4节给出了阅读的理由,第5节给出了最低,而不是计划导致粘贴的证据。

blocks.en:
Stated counts and required fields are known to push models toward content that is not there ( Yang, 2026 ; Ivgi et al., 2024 ; Usman, 2026 ) .
The closest study, PhantomFill ( Usman, 2026 ) , puts minimum-count arrays in JSON schemas, but its inputs hold no true items by construction and it does not vary the count.
No study we know of varies a schema count against the true count on real documents, compares a minimum with a maximum, or measures how much of the added content comes from the document itself.
We test eight open-weight models on one GPU, and six more on two hosted services, on 558 documents that hold 0 to 6 checked items.
Each model is asked for 1, 3 or 5 items, with the count in prose, in a schema shown in the prompt, or in a schema the decoder enforces.
The main measure is the length change: for the same document and model, the number of entries under a shown minimum minus the number with no count (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh:
据了解,已申报的计算和所需字段将模型推向不存在的内容(Yang, 2026;Ivgi等, 2024;Usman, 2026)。
最近的研究"幽灵档案"(Usman, 2026)将最小计数数数组放入了JSON schemas中,但其输入没有通过构造而持有真实项目,并且不会改变计数.
我们所知道的任何研究都不同实际文件实际数的计数办法,比较最低数和最高数,或衡量文件本身增加的内容有多少。
我们在一个GPU上测试了8个开放重量型号,另外在两个托管服务上测试了6个开放重量型号,在558个文件上测试了0至6个检查过的物品。
每个型号需要1,3或5个物品,计数为道具,计数为快取所显示的计数,或计数为解码器执行.
主要衡量长度变化:对于同一文档和模型,显示的最小下条目数减去无计数数(图2 ).

Black: the eight GPU models. Grey, below the line: hosted reference models on Together (T) and Bedrock (B), never pooled with the GPU models.
blocks.zh: 图 2:每个模型的主要对比度:在图中显示的分钟项目下的实质性条目减去没有计数的条目,同一文档,以n < k n<k,k=3 k=3和5为单位的文档,组-组间隔为95%。 黑色:8个GPU型号. Grey,下行:主机在College(T)和Bedrock(B)上的参考模型,从未与GPU模型集合.

blocks.en: We find three things (Section 4 marks which results are registered tests and which are exploratory or post hoc).
blocks.zh: 我们发现有三件事(第4节标记,结果为注册测试,是探索测试或事后测试)。

blocks.en:
Models treat the count as a target. A minimum shown in the schema, but not enforced, raises the share of lists longer than the true count from 34.5% to 55.4%: on the same documents, about one more list in five runs past the true count.
On the documents a model gets exactly right with no count, a shown minimum still makes about a third of its lists pad (35.2%; post hoc).
Six of the eight GPU models and all nine hosted runs lengthen their lists; the exceptions are the two smallest models, one of which often writes no readable list (Section 4.1 ).
Registered controls tie the effect to the slots the document cannot fill: a minimum adds nothing on documents that already hold enough items, and a shown maximum barely changes over-count (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
模型将计数视为目标. 在计划中显示的、但未得到执行的最低限度,比真实数长的列表份额从34.5%提高到55.4%:在同一文件中,大约五分之一的列表超过真实数。
在文件中,一个模型完全正确,没有计数,一个显示的最小值仍然占其列表垫的大约三分之一(35.2%;特设后)。
8个GPU模型中的6个和所有9个主机运行了它们的列表;例外是两个最小的模型,其中一个经常会写出无法读取的列表(第4.1节.
已注册的控件将效果与文档无法填充的空档相挂钩:对已经持有足够多项的文档,最少不添加任何内容,显示的最大仅勉强更改多数(第4.2节)。

blocks.en:
The padding is hard to catch. Most added entries are real text taken from the document, like the sign-off in Figure 1 .
They parse, meet the schema, and about half pass a check that each entry occurs in the source (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
垫地难接. 大多数增加的条目都是从文档取出的真实文本,如图1中的签出.
他们分析,满足了计划,大约一半通过检查,每个条目都发生在源头(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
Common fixes help only partly. A line saying fewer items are fine removes the effect on average but misses more true items.
An “N/A” option under an enforced minimum lowers padding only from 90.1% to 51.0%.
“Up to k k ” in prose also raises over-counting, from 34.5% to 42.7%.
Re-asking with the bare validation error, as schema-validating libraries do, made padding far more common in every run tested, from 10.0% to 69.0% for Qwen3.5-9B (Section 4.5 ).
blocks.zh:
共同的修补只是部分帮助。 说少一些项目是精细的一行可以消除平均效果,但漏掉了更真实的项目。
强制最低水平下的“不适用”选项只从90.1%降至51.0%。
在传教者中,“至kk”也使超额计算从34.5%上升到42.7%。
重新询问赤裸的验证错误,如图案验证库所做的那样,使得在每次测试中粘贴都更加常见,从10.0%到69.0%的Quen3.5-9B(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: Our contributions: • 558 real documents from nine annotated sets with answer lists checked by both authors, released with the code and run records (Section 3.1 , Appendix C ). • A preregistered, per-model measurement of count pressure on eight open-weight models, with controls, and six hosted models as a reference (Section 4 ). • Evidence that the padding is mostly real document text, with practical guidance for schema authors (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: • 9个附加说明文件的558个真实文件,由两位作者核对答复清单,并附有代码和记录(第3.1节,附录C)。 对8个开放重量模型进行预先注册的、按模型衡量的计数压力,以控制为基准,以及6个主机模型(第4节)。 证明贴纸大多是真实的文档文本,并附有对计划作者的实用指导的证据(表4)。

blocks.zh: 9个注解组的558个真实文件,由两位作者核对答案清单,随密码发布并运行记录(第3.1节,附录C.)。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The closest study to ours, PhantomFill ( Usman, 2026 ) , builds inputs that hold no answer by construction, such as a post with engagement counts but no reply text, and finds that required JSON fields drive fabrication to 100% in ten of thirteen models and that open-weight models ignore an offered “insufficient evidence” value, even under enforced decoding.
Its schemas include minimum-count arrays, which GPT-5.5 filled with invented content in 3 of 20 trials.
Because its inputs hold nothing true, every filled slot is invented there.
Our documents hold some true items, so a padded list can also be filled with real text, and we vary k k against n n . Yang (2026) states an error count in prose for CoNLL-2014 passages of learner English: moving it from two below the true count to two above moves the reported count of four GPT and Claude models by 82 to 94% of that gap, with one case of GPT-4o inventing errors to reach the stated number, while Gemini models barely move. Ivgi et al. (2024) ask, from memory, for 25 facts where at most 10 exist, and lists move from correct facts to invented ones and then to repetitions.
Neither uses a schema or compares a minimum with a maximum.
Instruction-following benchmarks score such counts as goals to meet, for example “mention the keyword of AI at least 3 times” in IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) ; on a document with fewer items than asked, meeting the count and staying true to the document conflict.
blocks.zh:
我们最接近的研究是PhantomFill(Usman, 2026 年), 构建了无法通过构建来回答问题的投入, 例如一个有约定数却无回复文本的帖子,
其计划包括了最小计数阵列,GPT-5.5在20个试验中的3个中被被发明的内容所填充.
因为它的投入不真实,每个被填入的空档都是在那里发明的.
我们的文档持有一些真实的项目,因此一个添加列表也可以被真实文本所填充,而我们则将 k k 与 n n 相变 。 杨(2026年)表示为学习者英语的CONLL-2014段落的道词中存在一个错误计数:从真实计数下的两个移到上面的两个,将所报告的4个GPT和克洛德模型的计数以该缺口的82-94%移动,其中一例为GPT-4o发明出错误以达到所声明的数字,而双子座模型几乎动不了. 伊夫吉等编. (2024年)从记忆中询问最多有10个事实的25个事实,列表从正确的事实转移到发明的事实再到重复.
既不使用计划,也不将最低值与最高值进行比较。
遵循指示的基准对达到的目标等计分,例如在IFEval(周等,2023年)中“至少记出3次AI的关键词”;在项目少于要求的文件上,满足计分,并忠实于文件冲突。

blocks.en:
Two audits find that most false positives of model-based extraction are real text, not invention.
In Han et al. (2024) , spans the test set does not annotate are 11.7 to 48.5% of GPT-4’s errors on four information-extraction tasks, while spans absent from the input are 0 to 4.3%. Qian (2026) audits entity extraction from threat-intelligence reports under a preregistered protocol and estimates that 65.6% of false positives are background mentions, correct strings from the wrong context, against 1.2% with no support in the report; a hard cap of three items raised the precision of one entity type from 0.060 to 0.381.
Neither sets a minimum count.
We find the same kind of error under count pressure, where the minimum itself asks for it.
blocks.zh:
两项审计发现,模型取出的大多数假阳性都是真实的文字,而不是发明.
在Han等人(2024年)中,测试集的跨度没有标注GPT-4在四项信息采集任务上的误差的11.7%至48.5%,而输入中缺失的跨度为0至4.3%. Q(2026年)审计实体从事先登记的协议下的威胁-情报报告提取,并估计65.6%的假阳性是背景所提及,从错误的上下文中纠正出弦,而报告里没有支持的为1.2%;一个实体类型的硬封顶从0.060提高到了0.381.
也没有设定最低的计数。
我们发现同样的错误 在计数压力下, 最低要求本身。

blocks.en:
Output formats change what models produce: JSON and similar formats lower reasoning accuracy, more so the stricter the format ( Tam et al., 2024 ) . Lee et al. (2026) separate a format requested in the prompt from a format enforced by the decoder and find that the prompt causes most of the accuracy loss on reasoning tasks.
Our shown and enforced conditions make the same split for a count: the prompt and schema are identical, and only the decoder differs.
JSONSchemaBench tests six constrained-decoding frameworks, XGrammar among them, on 10K real-world schemas for efficiency, coverage of constraint types and output quality ( Geng et al., 2025 ) ; it asks whether the decoder meets the schema, and we ask what the model puts in the slots the schema forces.
Grammar-constrained decoding can also distort the model’s distribution, giving grammatical outputs at likelihoods out of proportion to the model’s own ( Park et al., 2024 ) , one reason an enforced minimum need not behave like a shown one.
blocks.zh:
输出格式改变模型生成的内容: JSON和类似格式的推理精度更低,更严格的格式(Tam等,2024.). 李等编. (2026)从解码器所执行的格式中分离出所请求的快取格式,并发现快取导致推理任务大部分的准确性损失.
我们所显示和强制执行的条件对一个计数作出同样的分法:即时和计数方法相同,只有解码器不同.
JSONSchema Bench测试了6个受限解码框架,其中XGrammar在10K现实世界的计数器上,以提高效率,覆盖约束类型和输出质量(Geng等,2025年);它询问解码器是否符合计数器,我们询问模型在计数器的插槽中放置了什么.
语法限制的解码也可以扭曲模型的分布,可能使语法输出量与模型本身不成比例(Park等,2024年),一个被强制的最小值不需要像显示的那样行为的原因.

blocks.en:
Saying that a list is short is a form of abstention, which is studied mostly as declining to answer questions that are underspecified or unanswerable ( Wen et al., 2025 ) .
AbstentionBench finds that reasoning fine-tuning lowers abstention by 24% on average ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) , in line with our thinking side test, where thinking raised padding for two of three models.
Our “fewer is fine” line and N/A escape are abstention options inside a schema.
blocks.zh:
说清单很短是一种弃权形式,研究主要是拒绝回答不够具体或无法回答的问题(Wen等,2025年)。
(Kirichenko等人,2025年), 符合我们的思维侧式测试, 思考提升了三种模型中两种模型的支撑力。
我们的“弱点是好的”一行,而N/A越狱则是在计划内弃权的选择。

blocks.en: 3 Data and design
blocks.zh: 3 数据和设计

blocks.en:
A document has n n true items, the entries of its answer list.
A request asks for k k items; when k > n k>n it leaves k − n k-n forced slots that no true item can fill.
An output’s substantive entries are its entries that are neither placeholders (“N/A”, “none found”) nor string-level repeats of an earlier entry.
The output over-counts when it has more substantive entries than n n ; its excess is how many more.
An extra entry is a substantive entry that the item matcher (Section 3.4 ) does not match to a distinct true item.
Extra entries that the matcher finds in the document, verbatim or closely paraphrased, but that are not items of the kind asked for are grounded padding (the matcher’s “wrong kind” label).
A source check keeps only the entries that occur in the source document.
blocks.zh:
文档有 n 真实项,即其答案列表的条目。
请求要 Kk 项; 当 k > n k>n 时, 它会留下 k - n k - n 强制槽, 没有真项可以填充 。
产出的实质性条目是其既不是占位符(“N/A”,“没有找到”),也不是早先条目的串级重复。
产出在有比 n 更实质性的条目时会超额计算;其超额是多出多少.
附加条目是一个实质性条目,项目匹配者(第3.4节)与明显真实的项目不符。
匹配者在文档中发现的附加条目,无论是逐字的还是被仔细解释的,但并非所要求的那类项目是被禁入的(匹配者的"错误类型"标签).
源检查只保留源文档中发生的条目 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Documents and answer lists
blocks.zh: 3.1 文件和答复清单

blocks.en:
The 558 documents come from nine sets drawn from eight published datasets with human annotations of the items we ask for: action items in AMI meetings ( Carletta et al., 2006 ) , requests in MailEx emails ( Srivastava et al., 2023 ) , items on CORD receipts ( Park et al., 2019 ) , skills and, separately, knowledge (tools) in SkillSpan job ads ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) , medications in MACCROBAT case reports ( Caufield et al., 2019 ) , features in ROAST product reviews ( Chebolu et al., 2024 ) , people in Few-NERD Wikipedia sentences ( Ding et al., 2021 ) , and direct speech in PDNC novels ( Vishnubhotla et al., 2022 ) .
Each set has 15 documents for each n n from 0 to 3 (two cells hold 11 and 12; receipts and reviews have no n = 0 n=0 documents), and six sets add documents with n = 4 n=4 to 6 for asking fewer than exist (per-set totals in Table 9 ).
Long originals are cut into windows on sentence or speaker-turn boundaries, so each window holds a known number of whole items.
blocks.zh:
这558份文件取自8个已公布的数据集,其中附有我们要求的项目说明:AMI会议的行动项目(Carletta等,2006年),MailEx电子邮件中的请求(Srivastava等,2023年),CORD收据上的项目(Park等,2019年),技能以及分别的知识(工具),SkillSpan工作广告(Zhang等,2022年),MACCROBAT案例报告中的药物(Caufield等,2019年),ROAST产品审查中的特征(Chebolu等,2024年),NERD维基百科中句的人(Ding等,2021年),以及PDNC小说中的直接演讲(Vishnubhotla等,2022年).
每套有从0到3个n的15个文件(两个单元格有11个和12个;收据和审查没有n=0个n=0个文件),有6套增加以n=4个n=4到6个文件的要求少于存在(表9中的每套总数).
长的原作被切入句子或扬声器-转接边框上的窗口,因此每个窗口都持有已知的数个整件物品.

blocks.en:
The answer lists start from the datasets’ own annotations, which we cleaned under written counting rules that fix one reading for ambiguous cases, such as a request phrased twice.
We set the rules, including the five calls that move the most documents; an AI assistant applied them to all 1,446 candidate lists under our direction, keeping the annotators’ original beside every change; author B checked every resulting decision by hand; and we settled every case the rules left open.
Documents were dropped for recorded reasons, mostly that they had no single right count; the 558 study documents fill the design’s cells, and the reserve documents served only to develop the item matcher and the placeholder rules.
blocks.zh:
答案列表从数据集自己的说明开始,我们用书面计数规则来清理这些说明,这些规则为模棱两可的情况规定了一种读取方式,例如两次请求。

blocks.en: 3.2 Conditions
blocks.zh: 3.2 条件

blocks.en:
Every prompt is one user message: an instruction, the JSON schema pasted the way LangChain’s JsonOutputParser pastes it, then the document.
The schema describes the item in one line (each set’s line is quoted with its example in Appendix M ).
Table 1 lists the eight conditions; each runs at k = 1 k=1 , 3 and 5 (the no-count prompt does not depend on k k and is sent once), with all five wordings of each prose condition.
The schema conditions keep one instruction (“List all the requests.” for emails) and differ only in a minItems or maxItems keyword, an added line or the decoder; the shown and the enforced minimum send the same prompt.
The “fewer is fine” line is “If the document contains fewer than k k , list all available ones.”, adapted from a real extraction prompt in ScrapeGraphAI-100k ( Brach et al., 2026 ) .
The prose conditions replace the instruction with a count wording modelled on prompts from the same dataset, such as “Extract up to k k requests from this document.” or “Return the top k k requests.”, and keep the schema without a count (Table 14 ), so they differ from no count in the instruction as well as the count.

blocks.en: 3.3 Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式

blocks.en:
Eight open-weight models from five families run on one GPU: Qwen3.5-0.8B, -2B, -9B and -27B, Gemma 4 31B, Olmo 3.1 32B, Ministral 3 14B and gpt-oss-20b.
Each is pinned to a Hugging Face revision and served by vLLM v0.31.0 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with XGrammar 0.2.7 ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , in BF16 (gpt-oss-20b in its native MXFP4), with greedy decoding (temperature 0, seed 0) and thinking off; gpt-oss cannot turn reasoning off and runs at low effort.
We test open-weight models only.
Closed APIs, which carry much production extraction, are the main gap, and they may behave differently: in PhantomFill, GPT-5.5 filled a minimum-count array with invented content in only 3 of 20 trials ( Usman, 2026 ) .
As a reference, never pooled with the GPU models, six more open-weight models run on hosted services: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (thinking off) on Together AI in every condition, and Kimi K3 (thinking off), DeepSeek V3.2, Qwen3-235B, Mistral Large 3 and gpt-oss-120b on Amazon Bedrock in the unenforced conditions only, because Bedrock cannot enforce a minimum above 1.
Three GPU models also run hosted (Qwen3.5-9B on Together, Ministral 3 14B and gpt-oss-20b on Bedrock) to test whether the serving stack matters.
No Claude model is run, because a Claude model helped prepare the answer lists.

blocks.en: 3.4 Scoring
blocks.zh: 3.4 分数

blocks.en:
When n < k n<k , “List all the requests.” and the schema’s minItems cannot both be met with true entries, so the study has to say which one a correct output follows.
The registered plan chose the instruction, for three reasons.
The instruction is about the document in hand, while a schema is written once for a whole pipeline, before any document is seen; an instruction followed by the schema is the layout LangChain’s JsonOutputParser is built for.
A short list is correct data, and a placeholder or a note says that items are missing, while a padded list passes every format check and is wrong.
And a reading under which the minimum wins would accept any filler, invented entries included.
The main measure does not depend on this choice: the length change counts how far the stated number moves the list under either reading, and only calling the padding a failure rests on it.

当 n < k n < k > 时, “ 列出所有请求 ” 和 schema 的分钟项目都无法用真实的条目满足, 因此研究必须说明后面是哪个正确的输出 。
注册计划选择了指令,原因有三个。
指令是关于手头的文档,而整个管道都写过一次计划,在看到任何文件之前;计划后面的指令是LangChain的JsonoutputParrser的布局。
简短的列表是正确的数据,一个占位符或一个注释表示项目缺失,而一个加成列表则通过每个格式检查,是错误的.
和一个读数,根据它,最小赢者会接受任何填充, 发明的条目。
主要度量不取决于这个选择:长度变化算上标出的数字在两个读取下移动列表的多远,并且只有调取被标注的失败就在于它.

blocks.en:
Code reads every output through one parse ladder (strict JSON, a fenced block, the first object holding the list, a bare list, a cut-off list); a copy of the schema is never taken as the answer, so an output that only fills in a schema copy is unreadable.
The main measure is length change : the number of substantive entries under a condition minus the number under its comparison condition, for the same document and model (for contrast 2, a shown minimum against no count).
It needs the true count n n only to choose the documents with n < k n<k , not item-level matching, and because the comparison is paired, the extraction errors a model already makes with no count drop out of it. Over-count is the secondary measure.
Every output on a document with n < k n<k is also sorted as padded (it over-counts, even if it also flags the shortfall), says it is short (a placeholder, an “N/A” or a note), a short list with no note (at most n n substantive entries), or unreadable.
An item matcher labels every substantive entry as a true item, a split of one, grounded padding or invented, and gives the share of true items that no entry matches ( left out , on documents with n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 ).
The matcher was developed on reserve documents and frozen with the registered plan.
Against 400 entries that both authors labelled independently, it is right on 98% of its true-item (or split) calls, 85% of its wrong-kind calls and 69% of its invented calls, and only 5 of the 400 entries were true items missing from the answer lists (Appendix B ).
Its invented shares are therefore its least firm numbers; every number that rests on it is marked † .
No language model judges any headline number.

blocks.en: 3.5 Preregistration and statistics
blocks.zh: 3.5 预先登记和统计

blocks.en:
We froze a first plan, ran a pilot on 60 documents with three GPU and four hosted models, and registered the final plan on OSF ( https://osf.io/e4r9f ) before the full run.
Five contrasts are confirmatory and corrected together with Holm’s method: (1) a larger minimum, a shown minimum at k = 5 k=5 against k = 3 k=3 on the same document with n ≤ 2 n\leq 2 ; (2) a shown minimum against no count, the main measure; (3) a shown minimum against a shown maximum; (4) “exactly k k ” against “up to k k ”; and (5) the N/A escape against the plain enforced minimum, in excess entries per forced slot.
All are on documents with n < k n<k at k = 3 k=3 and 5.
For each, the one primary test is the 95% interval of the mean paired difference over documents and the eight GPU models, from 10,000 bootstrap draws over document groups (an original meeting, email folder, job ad, case report or novel chapter) within set; a mixed model (linear for contrasts 1 to 4, Poisson for contrast 5) and each model’s own estimate are reported next to it, per model first as the protocol asks.
Four named tests, three controls and an empty-document test, are reported whatever their result, outside the Holm family (Section 4.2 ).
The hosted runs, the per-set and per-wording results and the re-ask and thinking side tests are exploratory, and analyses added after the run are marked post hoc.
The interval describes these eight models on these documents; the per-model, family-level (Appendix D ) and hosted results speak to other models.

blocks.en:
A minimum shown in the schema lengthens lists for six of the eight GPU models, by 0.26 (Olmo 3.1 32B) to 1.68 entries (Gemma 4 31B), each with an interval above 0 (Table 2 , column C2).
Pooled over the eight, it adds 0.62 entries [0.46, 0.78] and raises over-count by 20.9 points [19.5, 22.3]: on the same documents, about one more list in five runs past the true count.
The estimate holds without the pilot documents, under the mixed model, with the five families weighted equally and with any one family left out (0.47 to 0.78; Appendices D and E ).

blocks.en:
The two smallest models are the exceptions.
Qwen3.5-2B lengthens its lists ( + 0.60 +0.60 ), but its interval spans 0.
Qwen3.5-0.8B often writes no readable list: 36.6% of its outputs are unreadable, mostly an answer written inside a copy of the schema, which the frozen rules count as 0 entries, so its estimate turns negative ( − 0.59 -0.59 ; Appendix G ).
Read with a lenient parser, it over-counts on about half its outputs both with no count and under a shown minimum (post hoc; Appendix M ).
Because unreadable outputs count as empty lists, this model pulls the pooled numbers down: without it, the main contrast is + 0.80 +0.80 entries [0.63, 0.96] and over-count rises from 35.0% to 59.8% (post hoc).
The registered pooled estimate is therefore the conservative one.

blocks.en:
The added entries are not true items that the no-count list missed: the share of true items left out (documents with n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 ) is 18.2% † under a shown minimum and 17.0% † with no count (Table 16 ).
Over all documents, an enforced minimum misses the fewest true items (recall 0.91 † , against 0.83 † with no count) because it adds the most entries, and prose “up to k k ” has the best entry F1 (0.60 † , against 0.53 † ; post hoc, Table 32 ).

The other confirmatory contrasts agree (Table 2 ).
Raising the shown minimum from 3 to 5 on the same document adds 0.61 entries (C1), about 0.3 per added slot; over-count barely moves, since a list already above n n at k = 3 k=3 cannot over-count twice, which is why the registered outcome is length.
A shown minimum gives 1.11 entries more than a shown maximum (C3), though this sums two opposite effects ( + 0.62 +0.62 and − 0.49 -0.49 against no count).
In prose, “exactly k k ” gives 0.10 entries and 8.2 over-count points more than “up to k k ” (C4).

blocks.en:
A count in prose pulls lists toward k k from both sides.
In every wording, both prose conditions shorten lists against no count ( − 0.43 -0.43 to − 1.02 -1.02 entries; Table 14 ), mostly by cutting long lists, yet the share that over-counts rises from 34.5% to 42.7% for “up to k k ” and 50.9% for “exactly k k ” (Table 16 ).
A mean length change can therefore hide padding, which is why over-count is reported beside it.
The prose conditions also replace the “List all” instruction, so part of their difference from no count may come from the wording rather than the count.

The effect holds with the annotators’ original counts, on documents whose list the cleanup kept or changed, and on n = 0 n=0 as on n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 documents (Appendix D ).

blocks.en:
Adding “If the document contains fewer than k k , list all available ones.” reverses the effect: lists end 0.77 entries shorter than with no count, and over-count falls 3.5 points below the no-count level (Table 3 ).
Seven of the eight models shorten their lists against the plain shown minimum, though Qwen3.5-27B still lists 0.46 entries more than with no count (Appendix F ).
The line has a cost: the share of true items left out rises from 17.0% † to 24.3% † (Table 16 ).
blocks.zh:
添加中 “如果文档中少于 kk ,请列出所有可用的条目。”
8个型号中,有7个型号对照显示的平原最小值来缩短名单,不过Quen3.5-27B仍然列出的条目比没有计数的多0.46个(附录F.
该线路有成本:遗漏的真正物品的比例从17.0%增加到24.3%(表16)。

blocks.en:
On documents that already hold at least k k true items, a shown minimum does not lengthen lists ( − 0.15 -0.15 entries [ − 0.30 -0.30 , − 0.02 -0.02 ]) and leaves true items left out unchanged.
On n < k n<k documents its effect exceeds this by 0.93 entries: the effect comes from filling the forced slots.
blocks.zh:
对于已经持有至少k克真品的文档,显示的最小值不长列表(- 0.15-0.15条目[- 0.30-0.30,- 0.02]),而将真品留出不变.
在 n < k n < k 文档中, 其效果超过 0. 93 个条目: 效果来自 填充被强制的槽 。

blocks.en:
On the 105 documents with no true item, even minItems: 1 , which asks only for a non-empty list, raises the share of outputs with at least one substantive entry from 34.9% with no count by 7.4 points when shown, and by 47.5 points, to 82.4%, when enforced.
The “fewer is fine” line and the N/A escape both bring it below the no-count level.
blocks.zh:
在105份没有真实项目的文件上,即使是小项目:1(只要求一份非空清单),至少将一个实质性条目的产出份额从显示时的34.9%不计数增加7.4分,执行时增加47.5分,增至82.4%。
“Fewer是罚款的”线,N/A逃出线使其都低于不计算水平。

blocks.en:
A shown maximum is not neutral: it shortens lists against no count ( − 0.49 -0.49 entries [ − 0.61 -0.61 , − 0.37 -0.37 ]), so it fails the protocol’s test for a harmless maximum.
It barely changes over-count (35.7% against 34.5%) but leaves out more true items (20.9% † against 17.0% † ).
blocks.zh:
显示的最大值不是中性:它比不计数(-0.49-0.49条目 [-0.61-0.61,-0.37-0.37])缩短清单,因此它没有达到协议对无害最大值的测试.
它几乎没有改变过高的计算(35.7%对34.5%),但漏掉了更真实的项目(20.9%对17.0%)。

blocks.en: 4.3 What the lists hold
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 名单里有什么

blocks.en: Figure 3: How outputs on documents with n < k n<k end, by condition, eight GPU models pooled, k = 3 k=3 and 5. Padded: more substantive entries than n n , even with a note. All columns: Table 16 .

blocks.en:
Over-count is not zero without a count: 34.5% of no-count outputs on n < k n<k documents already list more than n n substantive entries, mostly grounded padding (64.6% † ; Table 23 ).
This is ordinary extraction error, and each paired contrast measures what a condition adds to it on the same document and model.
On the documents a model gets exactly right with no count, a shown minimum makes 35.2% [33.0, 37.5] of its lists pad, against 5.0% under a shown maximum (post hoc; Table 33 ).
A shown minimum moves lists toward k k : the share with exactly k k entries rises from 5.6% to 35.5%, and 55.4% of outputs pad (Figure 3 ).
Enforced, the minimum leaves 0.6% of lists short of k k and 90.1% padded.
That much follows from the decoder, which all but rules out a shorter list; what the enforced condition shows is what fills the slots.
blocks.zh:
不计数的多计数不是零:n < k n < k 文档上34.5%的无计数产出已经列出超过n的实质性条目,大多是被固定的(64.6% ;表23)。
这是普通的提取出错,每个对齐的对比度量,一个条件在同一个文档和模型上增加了什么.
在文件中,一个模型完全正确,没有计数,显示的最小值为表垫的35.2% [33.0 37.5],而显示的最高值(后临时值;表33.)为5.0%。
显示最小移动列表为 kk : 包含 k 条目的占比从 5.6% 升至 35.5% , 输出板的占比为 55.4% (图 3)。
执行后,名单中至少有0.6%没有kk和90.1%加成。
这在很大程度上与解码器有关,除此之外,所有解码器都排除了一个更短的列表;强制条件显示的是哪些填充了空档.

blocks.en:
Most extra entries are grounded padding: 62.9% † under a shown minimum and 79.6% † under an enforced one, as in Figure 1 .
Most of the rest are invented: 29.5% † under a shown minimum, about the share with no count (29.8% † ), so the minimum adds both kinds in the proportions they already have; corrected with the authors’ labels, the invented share is 23.4% (post hoc; Appendix M ).
That makes the padding hard to catch: a source check removes invented entries, but 46.6% † of all extra entries under a shown minimum pass it (post hoc).
blocks.zh:
大部分附加条目都是被禁入的: 如图1所示,62.9% 低于规定的最低标准,79.6% 低于规定的最低标准。
其余大部分都是发明的:29.5% 的 QQ在显示的最小值下,大约是没有计数的份额(29.8% ) , 所以最小值会按照他们已经拥有的比例增加两种类型;用作者的标签纠正后,发明的份额是23.4%(临时后;附录M ) 。
这使得粘贴很难捕捉:一个源码检查删除了被发明的条目,但是在显示的最小通道(后临时通道)下所有额外条目的46.6%.

blocks.en:
Offering “N/A” under an enforced minimum cuts the excess entries per forced slot by 0.54 (rate ratio 0.57 in the Poisson mixed model), and every GPU model’s own estimate is below 0 (Table 2 ).
It is not a full fix: 51.0% of outputs still pad, and the two smallest models barely use it (Qwen3.5-0.8B still pads 89.6% of its outputs and Qwen3.5-2B 83.0%; Appendix G ).
blocks.zh:
在强制最低限值下提供“N/A”将每个强制插槽的超额输入减少0.54(Poisson混合模型中的比例为0.57),每个GPU模型自己的估计低于0(表2)。
它不是一个完整的固定点:51.0%的产出仍然固定下来,两个最小的模型几乎不用它(Quen3.5-0.8B仍然占其产出的89.6%和Quen3.5-2B 83.0%;附录G)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Hosted models and serving stack
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 主机模型和服务堆栈

blocks.en:
All nine hosted runs lengthen their lists under a shown minimum, by 0.28 (Ministral 3 14B on Bedrock) to 2.39 entries (DeepSeek V3.2; Figure 2 ), and give more entries under a minimum than under a maximum (Table 24 ).
For four of them (both DeepSeek models, Kimi K3 and Qwen3-235B), the “fewer is fine” line does not undo the effect: they still list 0.30 to 0.53 entries more than with no count.
The serving stack does not drive the result: for the three models run both on the GPU and hosted, the main contrast differs by at most 0.04 entries and 1.1 over-count points, within the registered limit of 10 points.
blocks.zh:
所有9个主机都按显示的最小值将其列表长度从0.28(Bedrock上的第3 14B部)到2.39个条目(DeepSeek V3.2;图2),并在最小值下给出比最高值下更多的条目(表24.).
对于其中的4个(DeepSeek models,Kimi K3和Quen3-235B),"fewer is fine"一行并不能消除效果:它们仍然列出比没有计数多出0.30到0.53个条目.
服务堆栈不驱动结果:对于在GPU和主机上运行的三种模型,主要对比点在最多0.04个条目和1.1个多计分点上,在10个点的注册限额内不同.

blocks.en: 4.5 Exploratory: re-asking and thinking
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 探索性:重新询问和思考

blocks.en:
Libraries that validate a schema send a failing reply back with the validation error.
We did this once for every shown-minimum reply shorter than k k , in five runs (four models, with Ministral 3 14B both on the GPU and on Bedrock).
Over-count among the re-asked outputs rose in every run: from 10.0% to 69.0% for Qwen3.5-9B and from 14.0% to 78.3% for Kimi K3 (Appendix K ).
The error restates the minimum, so complying with it is expected.
The point is practical: after the default retry, 44.0 to 81.6% of these short lists, truthful ones included, are padded.
A re-ask that adds “fewer is fine” was not tested.
blocks.zh:
用于验证一个 schema 的库会随验证错误发送一个失败的回覆 。
我们做了一次,每一次最短于 kk 的答覆, 共5次(有4个型号,
重复调查的产出的超额计算在每次运行中都有所增加:Quen3.5-9B从10.0 %增加到69.0%,Kimi K3(附录K)从14.0%增加到78.3%。
错误重述最小值, 因此需要遵守 。
这一点是实际的:在默认重试之后,这些短名单中有44.0%至81.6%(包括真实的短名单)是加成的。
未测试添加“罚款”的重新任务。

blocks.en:
Thinking does not help (Appendix L , Table 30 ).
For Qwen3.5-9B it makes padding worse: in each of three request seeds, contrast 2 is 1.1 to 1.2 entries larger with thinking on, and over-count under a shown minimum rises from 43–47% to 81–83%.
Kimi K3 moves the same way, less ( + 0.58 +0.58 entries on the pilot documents; its pair also differs in temperature).
Gemma 4 31B shows no length effect ( − 0.11 -0.11 [ − 0.23 -0.23 , 0.01]), though its over-count under a shown minimum rises from 61.8% to 66.1%.
The thinking often names the shortfall, in 88–89% of Qwen3.5-9B’s padded outputs by a phrase search, and the model pads anyway.
blocks.zh:
思考没有帮助(附录L,表30)。
用于 Wen3.5-9B 这更糟糕的是:在三个要求的种子中,相对的2是1.1到1.2个,在思考时更大,在显示的最低数量下,超值从43-47%上升到81-83%。
Kimi K3的移动方式相同,较少(在飞行员文档上+0.58+0.58条目;其配对在温度上也有所不同).
Gemma 4 31B没有显示长度效应(− 0.11-0.11 [− 0.23-0.23, 0.01]),尽管其超额计算显示的最低值从61.8%上升到66.1%。
想法常常将短缺点命名为:88-89%的Quen3.5-9B的添加出品通过短语搜索,以及模型垫子。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
In part it is: the model follows the schema over “List all”, and Section 3.4 gives our reasons for counting that as the failure.
The controls show that the minimum does this, not the schema or any number in it.
Under a shown maximum 35.7% of outputs over-count, against 34.5% with no count and 55.4% under a shown minimum.
A minimum adds no entries when the document already holds enough items.
Told that a shorter list is fine, seven of eight GPU models shorten their lists against the plain minimum, so most can stop.
What goes wrong is that the model meets the count with whatever text is at hand instead of saying the list is short.
blocks.zh:
其部分内容是:模型遵循的是“全部列出”,第3.4节给出了我们将它算作失败的理由。
控制显示最小值是这样做的,而不是计划或其中的任何数字。
在所显示的产出中,最多为35.7%,而未计算的产出为34.5%,低于所显示的最低产出为55.4%。
如果文档中的项目已经足够多, 则至少不添加条目 。
说一个更短的列表是好的,8个GPU模型中有7个对照平庸的最小值来缩短其列表,所以大多数可以停止.
出错的是,模型用手头的任何文本与伯爵相会,而不是说列表很短.

blocks.en:
Most of the padding is taken from the document: it parses, meets the schema, and about half of it passes a source check (Section 4.3 ), so the error shows in full only against an answer list.
This matches what Han et al. (2024) and Qian (2026) find for extraction without a minimum count, and differs from PhantomFill, where the inputs hold nothing to copy ( Usman, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
大部分地标取自文档: 它剖析出,满足了图案,大约一半通过源检查(第4.3节),因此错误完全显示只针对一个答案列表.
这与Han等人(2024年)和Qian(2026年)发现的没有最低限度统计的提取结果相匹配,也与"幽灵档案"(Phantom Fill)不同,其中输入内容没有任何内容可以复制(Usman,2026年).

blocks.en: Leave minItems off lists whose length the document decides (over-count 34.5% → \to 55.4% shown, 90.1% enforced).
blocks.zh: 将文件决定长度的项目从清单中扣除(超计34.5%-=55.4%,执行90.1%)。

blocks.en: If recall matters most, an enforced minimum misses the fewest true items but pads most; prose “up to k k ” balances the two best (F1 0.60 † vs 0.53 † ).
blocks.zh: 如果召回最重要,则被强制执行的最低数目少的是真实物品,但最多是铺垫;传言“最高为kk ”在两个最优之间(F1 0.60 †对0.53 †)。

blocks.en: Do not rely on a source check: about half of the padding passes it.
blocks.zh: 不要依赖源码检查: 大约一半的垫片通过它.

blocks.en: If a minimum must stay, add “fewer is fine” and test it: some models still lengthen their lists, and recall falls.
blocks.zh: 如果必须保留最低限度,则加上“Fewer是罚款的”并测试:有些型号仍在延长其名单,召回则下降。

blocks.en: An “N/A” option under enforcement helps but is not a fix (90.1% → \to 51.0% padded).
blocks.zh: 执行中的“N/A”选项有帮助,但不是固定的(90.1%~\到51.0%的加法)。

blocks.en: Do not re-ask with the bare validation error (Qwen3.5-9B: 10.0% → \to 69.0% over-count).
blocks.zh: 不要重新询问赤裸的验证错误( Quen3.5- 9B: 10.0 % ~\ to 69.0% 超计) 。

blocks.en: maxItems barely changes over-count but shortens lists and leaves out more true items.
blocks.zh: 最大项目几乎不会改变过多的计算,但会缩短清单,留下更真实的项目。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
When a document holds fewer items than a schema’s minimum, most of the open-weight models tested treat the count as a target and pad their lists: a shown minimum raises the share of over-counting lists from 34.5% to 55.4%, and an “N/A” option under an enforced minimum still leaves half of them padded.
The added entries are mostly real text taken from the document, so about half of them pass a source check.
A “fewer is fine” line undoes the effect on average at some cost in recall, while re-asking with the validation error makes padding far more common, and thinking does not help.
blocks.zh:
当一个文件所持有的物品少于计划的最低值时,大多数被测试的开量模型都把计数作为目标并固定其清单:一个显示的最低值将超计清单的份额从34.5%提高到55.4%,而强制最低值下的“N/A”选项仍然留有一半。
所添加的条目大多是从文档中取出的真实文本,因此其中约一半通过源码检查.
“Fewer is fine”一行以某种代价抵消了平均影响,而重新询问验证错误则使铺垫更为常见,思维也无济于事。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Every list item is one string (a quote, a name or, for meetings, a summary sentence); lists of records with several fields, where padding would force invented field values, are not tested.
One grammar engine (XGrammar) is used; a second engine gave different outputs in a pre-study test.
The schema is always pasted in the prompt, in LangChain’s format, and k k takes the values 1, 3 and 5.
No closed model is run, and closed APIs may pad less (Section 3.3 ); the six conditions with a free decoder run on any API, so they are the natural next test.
blocks.zh:
每个列表项是一个字符串(一个引号,一个名称,或者,对于会议来说,一个摘要句);包含多个字段的记录列表,其中的活字会强制被发明的字段值,不进行测试.
一个语法引擎(XGrammar)被使用;第二个引擎在预研测试中给出了不同的输出.
计程器总是用快取来粘贴的,用LangChain的格式来粘贴,而kk取取值1,3和5.
不运行闭合型号,闭合型号的API可能会被降低(第3.3节);在任意API上运行自由解码器的6个条件,因此它们是自然的下一个测试.

blocks.en:
The answer lists fix one reading for each ambiguous case, so the blind check measures agreement with the written rules; job-ad skills is the least certain set.
For this reason the main measure needs only the true count, and the confirmatory contrasts are also given with the annotators’ original counts.
Numbers marked † rest on the item matcher, which does not assign the labels “true item the list missed” and “text from beyond the excerpt”; its invented shares are its least firm numbers.
Thinking traces are read only by a phrase search, not by hand.
The share of outputs that note a shortfall outside the list is a lower bound, because the frozen note rules miss some wordings.
blocks.zh:
答案列表为每个模棱两可的案件固定一个读取,因此盲目检查措施与书面规则的协议;工作技能是最小的确定设定.
因此,主要衡量标准仅需要真实的计数,并且还给出了与注释者最初计数的校正对比。
标有 Q 的号码在项目匹配器上,它没有指定“所遗漏的正确项目”和“摘录以外的文本”;它发明的股份是它最不确定的号码。
思考痕迹只通过一个短语搜索来读取,而不是用手来读取.
显示清单之外出现短缺的产出份额较低,因为被冻结的注解规则没有采用某些措辞。

blocks.en:
Decoding is greedy outside the thinking test, but repeated prompts did not always give the same reply: the over-count verdict changed for at most 3.0% of GPU prompts and 8.0% of Bedrock prompts sent twice (Appendix J ).
Two chat templates add a system prompt of their own (Olmo 3.1 a default one, gpt-oss one with the current date).
Hosted models are a reference, with no pinned revision or serving stack.
The novel texts lost their non-ASCII characters; the CORD receipts are Indonesian and the other sets English.
The documents fill fixed cells of up to 15 per set and true count, and documents with no single right count were dropped, so how often a real pipeline meets n < k n<k is not measured here.
In public schemas a minimum on a list of strings or objects is almost always 1 (Appendix M ), so the k = 1 k=1 test matches the common case and k = 3 k=3 and 5 a rarer one.
blocks.zh:
解码在思维测试之外是贪婪的,但重复的提示并不总是给出相同的回复:过高的判定以最多3.0%的GPU提示和8.0%的贝德罗克提示两次发送(Appendix J.
两个聊天模板都增加了自己的系统提示(Olmo 3.1是默认的,gpt-oss one带有当前日期).
主机模型是一种参考,没有被绑定的修订版或服务堆栈.
小说文本失去了他们的非ASCII字符;CORD收据是印度尼西亚文,而其他的则是英文.
文件填入了每套最多为15个的固定单元格和真实的点数,并且投放了没有单一的正数的文档,因此一个真实的管线经常满足 n < k n < k > k 。
在公共计划中,字符串或对象列表上的最小值几乎总是1(Appendix M),因此k=1克=1的测试与常见的大小写相匹配,而k=3克=3和5是更罕见的.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
All nine sets come from public datasets, used under their licences (Table 7 ).
The reviews set’s annotations are Apache-2.0, but its review text states no licence, so it is not redistributed: those documents are rebuilt locally from the original source, and the release carries only their identifiers and text hashes.
The Enron emails are real people’s mail, public since 2003; the clinical case reports are published in PubMed Central.
MailEx, Few-NERD and the Stack Overflow (TECH) job ads of SkillSpan are share-alike, so a released benchmark that contains their text is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
The hosted runs sent the study prompts, review documents included, to Together AI and Amazon Bedrock for inference.
All human labelling and checking was done by the two authors; no crowd workers or other participants were involved.

主机运行将研究提示,包括审查文件发送给了共同AI和Amazon Bedrock进行推论.
所有的人的标签和检查都由两位提交人完成;没有涉及人群工人或其他参与者。

blocks.en: AI-use statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用说明

blocks.en:
We used an AI coding assistant (Kiro, running Claude Opus 5.5) for implementation and drafting.
The authors conceived the study, made every design decision, and did every human judgement in it: we set the counting rules and settled the cases they left open, did the blind checks, labelled the 400 matcher-validation entries independently, and checked or recounted 135 scored outputs by hand.
The assistant wrote and tested the code, ran and logged the experiments, checked citations against the cited papers, and drafted text that we revised.
It also made a first pass applying our counting rules to the 1,446 candidate answer lists; author B then checked every resulting decision by hand.
No AI output was used as a human label, and the item matcher is evaluated only against our labels.
No Claude model is among the models tested.
We take full responsibility for the content.

blocks.en:
One author reads 65 pilot replies (40 drawn at random, the 3 outputs cut at the token limit and all 22 unreadable ones) against the scorer: parse rung, substantive entries, placeholders, repeats, over-count.
The author and the scorer agree fully on 61 of the 65.
The 4 differences all come from how the frozen scorer reads an output.
In one, the author counts as a repeat an entry that restates an earlier one with a three-word prefix; the scorer counts as repeats only entries with the same or nearly the same words (overlap threshold 0.85, here 0.67) and leaves the rest to the matcher.
In three, the reply is cut at the token limit inside an entry; the author counts the unfinished entry and the scorer keeps only entries that close before the cut, so in one of them the author sees an over-count the scorer does not.
No scorer bug was found, so nothing is rescored.

一位作者对计分员阅读了65个试点答复(40个随机抽取,3个产出被划入象征性限度,所有22个无法读取):解析数、实质性条目、占位符、重复数、多计数。
作者和计分员完全同意65分中的61分.
4个区别都来自被冻结的计分器如何读取一个输出.
在一个词中,作者算作重复了一条,重复了前面一个有三字前缀的条目;计分者算作重复的只是重复了相同或几乎相同词的条目(重叠阈值为0.85,此处为0.67),剩下的则留给了匹配者.
在3个中,回复被切到一个条目内的符号限制;作者计算未完成的条目,计分员只保留切出前已关闭的条目,所以在其中之一中,作者看到一个计分员没有的多计分.
没有找到计分器错误, 所以没有重新计分 。

blocks.en:
The matcher matches names after normalising case and punctuation, quotes by fuzzy substring search, and meeting action items by similarity to each answer item and its transcript lines.
Both authors label 400 entries alone, blind to the model, condition, k k , the other entries and the matcher’s label, then settle the differences.
They chose the same label for 370 of the 400 entries (92.5%; Cohen’s kappa 0.896, Gwet’s AC1 0.912) and settled the other 30 together; the settled label is the reference.
Table 6 gives the matcher against it.
The matcher gave no study entry the labels “true item the list missed” or “text from beyond the excerpt”, so those strata are empty and their places went to the other three.
The invented share of substantive entries is 7.0% as the matcher gives it and 7.3% weighted by the authors’ labels.
Five entries were settled as true items the list missed; they go into the answer-list overlay with the document’s wording and the authors’ reason ( analysis/gold_overlay.jsonl ; the one review item’s text is in the local restricted file), and with the overlay applied contrasts 1 to 4 are the same to two decimals and contrast 2 on over-count moves from + 20.9 +20.9 to + 21.1 +21.1 points.

blocks.en:
For 10 documents with n < k n<k , each paired with one GPU model, one author counts the substantive entries of 7 outputs by hand (70 outputs) and computes length change, over-count, true items left out and the sorting.
The hand count agrees fully with the scorer on 60 of the 70.
In 7 (Qwen3.5-0.8B on one email), the model wrote its list inside a copy of the schema; the frozen parser counts that as unreadable with 0 entries while the author reads the list, and three length changes follow from it.
In 3 (gpt-oss-20b on one meeting), the matcher matched an entry naming another task or person to the one true item on shared words, so the scorer counts no true item left out and the author counts one; the author is right, and this is the kind of error check (b) measures.

On 40 documents from eight sets, each author counted the items alone, without seeing the answer lists.
Author A matched the list’s count on 35 (87.5%; 95% Wilson interval 74 to 95%), author B on 38 (95.0%), and A and B agreed on 35 (AC1 0.851), passing the registered thresholds of 85% and 0.80; 15 of the 40 were marked unclear by either author.

No answer list was changed after the check.
The reviews set, whose text may not be shared, was counted the same way in a separate check of five documents: author A matched the list on all five, author B on four, and the two agreed on four.
Both authors read the 60 pilot documents with their lists during the cleanup review.

A developer can check that each extracted entry occurs in its source document. We test two versions: the entry, normalised for case, quotes, dashes and spaces, as an exact substring of the normalised document, and a fuzzy match (partial ratio of at least 90).
The check removes invented entries: 0.6% of the matcher’s invented entries pass, and none of the 99 entries the authors labelled invented passes either version.
It lets most grounded padding through (67.7% exact) and about half of all extra entries (46.6% under a shown minimum), against 80.6% of true-item entries (Table 31 ).
Meetings sit apart: their items are one-sentence summaries, not copies, so only 7.5% of their extra entries pass.

开发者可以检查每个被提取的条目在其源文档中是否发生. 我们测试两个版本:条目,为大小写、引文、破折叠和空格,作为普通文件的精确下字符串,和模糊相配(至少90个部分比例)。
该检查删除了发明的条目: 0.6%的配对者发明的条目通过, 而被标注的作者发明的99个条目中没有一个通过任何版本。
它让大多数被禁入(准确的67.7%)和大约一半的额外条目(最低显示的46.6%)通过,而真实条目的80.6%(表31)。
会议分开进行:他们的项目是一判决摘要,不是副本,所以他们额外录入的通行证只有7.5%.

We count list minimums in the 9,542 real-world schemas of JSONSchemaBench ( Geng et al., 2025 ) (MIT licence, revision 5bd0f46 ), leaving out fixed-length arrays and tuples such as coordinates (Table 34 ).
Half the schemas hold an array; 7.7% put a minItems of at least 1 on a list of strings or objects, and 0.3% (24 schemas) one of 2 or more, such as a list of players or of interests.
The common schema minimum is therefore 1, the case of the empty-document test (Section 4.2 ); larger minimums are rare in public schemas.
The function-calling subset (Glaiveai2K) sets none ( analysis/posthoc/schema_prevalence.py ).
